thugs rje chen po'i rgyun khyer zab lam snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ /gar gyi dbang phyug thugs rje'i bdag/bla ma nyid la phyag 'tshal nas/ /snying por

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs rje chen po'i rgyun khyer zab lam snying por dril ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300gar gyi dbang phyug thugs rje'i bdag /bla ma nyid la phyag 'tshal nas//

snying por dril ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs// mdo tsam 'dir ni gsal bar bya// nges 'byung blo yis dben pa'i sar// bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni// mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul kun// sprin phung gtibs pa lta bur bsam/ na mo/ bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub bar// bla ma sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos// tshogs mchog bde gshegs dkyil 'khor lha// mkha' 'gror bcas la skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ brgal dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las// mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// lan gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog / ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ sras bcas rgyal ba 'khor bcas la// gus pas btud de phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa'i// mchod pa kun gyis yang dag mchod// tshe rabs thog med nas byas pa'i// sdig pa'i las rnams mthol zhing bshags// sems can kun la phan mdzad pa'i// dge ba kun la yi rang ngo*// sangs rgyas mya ngan 'da' bzhed gang*// bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs su gsol// gdul bya'i bsam pa ji bzhin du// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// bsod nams gang zhig bgyis pa rnams// thams cad byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes skyabs sems yan lag bdun sngon 'gros dngos gzhi 'di la 'jug / chos kun spros bral de bzhin nyid// 'gag med kun snang snying rje'i rtsal// zung 'jug 'gyur med yi ge hrīḥ de las rang byung gzhal yas khang*// dwangs gsal sgrib med 'od lnga'i klong*// padma nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng*// hrīḥyig utpal dmar po las// bde gshegs kun 'dus spyan ras gzigs// dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// yid 'ong khro 'dzum chags nyams rgyas// phyag bzhi'i dang po thal sbyar bar// rdo rje 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud// gnyis pa pad phreng utpal 'dzin// zhabs gnyis g.yo med skyil krung bzhugs// pang du gsang ba ye shes yum// dmar gsal gzhon tshul lang tsho rgyas// phyag bzhi gri thod ral gri dang*/

kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin pa yab la 'khyud// gnyis ka dar dang rin chen dang*// rus pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes// thugs kar dpa' bo rta mgrin dang*// spyi bor rigs bdag 'od dpag med// 'khor du rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong sprul dang yang sprul bcas// mtha' yas 'od zer spro ba'i tshul// gnas gsum oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ mtshan// ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur rdzogs// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hrīḥhūm̐ trāṃ oṃ āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// ye shes lha tshogs bkug par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba sa ma ya e ā ralli hring hring sa ma ya dza dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ spyan drangs gnyis med bstim phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa'i// dpag yas mchod pa 'di dag kun// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba pū dza sa ma ya hoḥ hrīḥ khyab gdal bde chen chos dbyings las// 'gag med gzugs sku'i rol par shar// bde gshegs kun 'dus spyan ras gzigs// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas mchod cing bstod byas nas// thugs kar pad nyir hrīḥyig la// sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod byin rlabs bsdus// sems can sgrib sbyangs byang chub bkod// snod bcud ye shes 'khor lor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ zhes pa'i bzlas pa ci nus bya// phyi nang snod bcud 'od du zhu// thugs ka'i hrīḥl gyen rdzogs su// mi dmigs spros bral dbyings su thim// slar yang 'phags pa'i sku ru gyur// dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun// bde chen gar dbang skur 'grub nas// sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan pa'i// go 'phang myur du thob par shog / ces pa o rgyan rnam grol gyis// nyams len khyer bder bskul ba las// 'gyur med rdo rjes bris pa ste// zab lam snying por dril ba 'o/// /bkra shis brjod pa ni/

oṃ/ byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs brgya'i bdag /bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dngos grub char 'beb zhi dang khro// yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog /thogs med phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog /gang la bsam pa'i don kun 'grub// dge legs mchog gi bkra shis shog / ces pa sogs kyi bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod pas dge legs su bya'o//
